description: grant the test user DSN-specific ego.dsn.read and ego.dsn.write (dsns_auth records, not identity permissions) so @sql can open the now-Restricted DSN. AuthDSN's bitmask check is satisfied by either bit since @sql always opens with DSNWriteAction+DSNReadAction combined (sql.go), but both are granted here so later table_perms denials (sql-07/sql-08) are unambiguously about the table, not the DSN.
